summary: This bill prohibits the Nuclear Regulatory Commission from issuing new licenses for the interim storage of spent nuclear fuel or high-level radioactive waste at facilities other than those with an operating nuclear reactor or federally owned sites, or for long-term storage/disposal at non-federally owned repositories, and nullifies any such existing licenses.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses the storage of spent nuclear fuel and high-level radioactive waste, which are significant environmental concerns due to their potential for harm. By restricting where these materials can be stored and nullifying existing licenses for certain interim storage facilities, the bill aims to enhance public safety and environmental protection related to nuclear waste management. This is a central aspect of the bill.
